1. III-V-on-Si μTP Hazards & Legacy Limits
A. PDMS Stamp Creep Misalignment (340nm → 3.8 dB)
• Elastomer stamp shear creep shifts QD coupon placement 340.0 nm
• Exceeds 120.0 nm adiabatic supermode taper registration limit
• III-V-to-Si coupling loss spikes from 0.42 dB to 3.8 dB (-60% light)
✗ Post-anneal LIV probers detect misalignment only after wafer bond
B. Interfacial H2O/H2 Outgassing Voids (180nm)
• Silanol condensation (Si-OH + HO-Si → Si-O-Si + H2O) releases vapor
• Traps 180nm voids beneath III-V laser mesa during 300°C anneal
• Blocks thermal path → 110°C CW laser facet burnout (COMD)
✗ Requires 13ms IR void sensing + +35s N2 radical pre-bond purge
C. 990K EPS Write Tax & 412M DRAM Vector Bloat
• AWS SiteWise / Cloud Gateways: $205,000/mo per-attribute fees
• 412M (>410M!) FDTD/peel vectors in DRAM: $48,880/mo cluster
• Cross-cloud ETL + 8,600-user BI concurrency: $38,220/mo
✗ Stitched 4-Cloud Total: $292,100/mo ($785K/mo Full-Stack)
